covers.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a project cover image for SystemEdu's space exploration learning website for children aged about 10-12. Create a finished premium raster editorial illustration, cinematic tactile 3D-style concept art with subtle painterly texture, believable spacecraft proportions and crisp focal subject, inviting scientific exploration, sophisticated rather than babyish. Landscape 3:2 composition, subject comfortably inside central 70% so image also crops well to 16:9. Consistent palette: deep midnight navy, warm copper terrain, ivory spacecraft, restrained pale gold light. Fill the frame edge to edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no website UI, no grids, no HUD. This is an evocative project cover, not a screenshot or instructional diagram. Subject: photographing the Moon through a telescope. Show a finely detailed cratered Moon dominant in the upper central night sky, with a compact ivory astronomical telescope and camera attachment in the near foreground on a quiet rocky observation ridge, pointing toward the Moon. Distinct dark lunar maria, raking sunlight on craters, sparse delicate stars. Sense of a first exciting observation, beautiful depth and warm reflected light, ample dark blue sky. No people, no other planets, no giant rings.
